# 성시원 제조 AI 아카이브 (sianism manufacturing-AI archive)

> A personal manufacturing-AI knowledge archive run by an individual, 성시원 (sianism). Not a company site or a news outlet. Each post is kept here in Korean and English. Author: 성시원 (sianism), 책임연구원 in service planning at INTERX (인터엑스), a manufacturing AI company. Posts are personal summaries based on public sources, not official company positions.

Each post exists in Korean (ko) and English (en); the Korean page is the original.

## Posts

- [중소 제조기업 AI 도입, 무엇부터 준비하나? 미리 챙길 데이터 5가지 (체크리스트 + FAQ)](https://sungsiwon.github.io/ko/ai-data-readiness-small-manufacturers/) (2026-10-23, 한국어): 중소 제조기업이 AI 도입 전에 준비할 데이터 5가지 체크리스트와 데이터 품질(ISO/IEC 25012)·KAMP 데이터셋·정부 지원 FAQ 6문항.
- [Before AI, Get Your Data Ready: 5 Datasets Small Manufacturers Should Prepare (with Korea's Policy Context)](https://sungsiwon.github.io/en/ai-data-readiness-small-manufacturers/) (2026-10-23, English): Five kinds of data a small manufacturer should prepare before AI, with Korea's 2025 smart manufacturing survey, ISO/IEC 25012 and KAMP datasets.
- [AI 자율제조 vs 스마트팩토리 vs MES, 뭐가 다를까? (자주 묻는 질문 정리)](https://sungsiwon.github.io/ko/ai-autonomous-manufacturing-vs-smart-factory-vs-mes/) (2026-10-21, 한국어): MES·스마트팩토리·AI 자율제조의 차이를 비교표와 FAQ 6문항으로 정리(산업부 AI 자율제조 전략 1.0, ISA-95, 스마트공장 수준).
- [AI Autonomous Manufacturing vs Smart Factory vs MES: an FAQ (with Korea's policy context)](https://sungsiwon.github.io/en/ai-autonomous-manufacturing-vs-smart-factory-vs-mes/) (2026-10-21, English): How MES, smart factory and AI autonomous manufacturing differ, with a comparison table, FAQ and Korea's AI Autonomous Manufacturing policy context.
